It did not add production app, backend, camera, AR, analytics, AI generation, OpenAI/external API usage, training, App Store/TestFlight, online release, or real user record collection.

nextAction: Proceed to Phase 9A: Internal Trial Operations Pack. Phase 8E is complete. Prepare internal small-scope trial operations materials without adding production app, backend, database, camera, AR, training, OpenAI API, external API, native iOS, React Native, Flutter, ecommerce, community, paid features, analytics, accounts, online publication, App Store/TestFlight, service worker, offline cache, push notification, background sync, install tracking, AI content generation, or real user data collection.
risks: Letting Phase 9A become production launch operations instead of internal trial operations planning
Treating Phase 8E go/no-go as App Store/TestFlight or production release approval
Collecting real names, contact information, photos, health data, sensitive identity data, analytics records, or training data before a future explicit approval gate
Weakening UserAppTemplatePackage as the stable handoff contract
forbiddenActions: Do not train directly from SourceImagePackage or user photo/profile/preference/recommendation/session/readiness/browser QA/release readiness/go-no-go data.
Do not expand legacy frozen modules.
Do not weaken the UserAppTemplatePackage boundary; the future React Web / PWA MVP must consume exported contract data and cannot mutate Makeup Engine production state.

Do not treat Phase 8E MVP release readiness or trial go/no-go as production release, App Store/TestFlight, backend readiness, analytics readiness, camera readiness, AR readiness, AI generation approval, OpenAI/external API approval, training readiness, online publication, or real user data collection approval.

Do not use Phase 8E go_for_internal_trial or go_with_warnings as permission to collect real user names, contacts, photos, health information, sensitive identity data, biometrics, backend records, analytics records, or training data.
Do not mutate UserAppTemplatePackage from Phase 8E release readiness, trial go/no-go, sessions, preferences, recommendations, content QA, feedback, or admin panels.
Do not write real release readiness, go/no-go, or trial participant records into project-state or training datasets.
